text: I've been trying to get through for ages now so I'm putting it all in one message. I'm a childminder and I've got a 2 year old girl staying over tonight while her parents are away, I've got their permission letter. She's had a temperature today, 38.8 at the last check. With calpol and ibuprofen in between she's honestly been fine, running round, drinking her juice, chattering away to me. Nappies are wet as normal, I changed a full one an hour ago. She's wide awake right now, watching cartoons and answering me when I talk to her. What I want someone to look at is her legs and tummy. When I changed her I noticed tiny dots, like someone's dotted her with the tip of a fine pen, plus a couple of bigger darker purply patches on her shin that look like bruises, except she hasn't banged herself, I've been with her all day. I pressed the side of a glass tumbler on them like you're supposed to and I could still see every one of them clearly through it. They didn't go away. I need someone to tell me what to do with this tonight.
